summary.headline: Astrological Chapters 202–214
summary.text: Chapters 202–214 of an astrological codex catalogue, covering rumor verification, Persian four-turning-of-the-year investigations, lunar house rulers, Saracen abundance, zodiacal signs, annual horoskops, omens, war and enemies, illness and death, commerce, planetary transfers, and the beginning of chapter 214. References compare Venetian and Vienna codices and note missing folios and excerpts from Theophilus.
